title: Field degree and logarithmic scale
statement: Let $n$, $a$, and $b$ be positive integers with $2a \le b$, and define the scale $S=\lceil nb/a\rceil$. The field degree $\max(1,\lceil\log_2 S\rceil)$ equals $\lceil\log_2 S\rceil$.
